content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification covers 1 vacancy for the post of Chief Engineer (Category-II ports) in Class-I (HOD) classification.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the following essential qualifications and eligibility criteria: Educational Qualification: Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution. Experience: Fifteen years experience in executive cadre in Planning/ Construction/ Design/ Maintenance preferably of Port and Marine Structures in an Industrial/ Commercial/ Govt. Undertaking. Deputation Eligibility: Officers holding posts in the scale of Rs. 80000-220000 (Pre-revised Rs. 32900-58000) with three years regular service in the grade in the Civil Engineering Department of a Major Port Authority; OR Officers holding post of Chief Engineer and equivalent posts in the Civil Engineering Department in the scale of Rs. 100000-260000 (pre-revised Rs. 43200-66000/ 18500-450-23900) with two years regular service in the grade or Officers holding post of Deputy Chief Engineer and equivalent posts in the Civil Engineering Department in the scale of pay of Rs. 80000-220000 (Pre-revised Rs. 32900-58000/ 16000-20800) and above with five years regular service in the grade in the Central Government or State Government or Union Territory Administration / Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies (other than Major Port Authorities). Age Limit: Upper age limit for direct recruitment is 45 years (Note: Age limit rules apply as specified for direct recruitment/absorption/deputation). content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a revised scale of pay of Rs. 1,00,000-2,60,000 (Pre-revised Rs. 43200-66000). After completion of three years' regular service in the post, the incumbent will be elevated to the scale of pay of Rs. 120000-280000 (pre-revised Rs. 51300-73000) subject to fulfilling relevant conditions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mormugao Port Authority Chief Engineer
content_sections.text: Access the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways website at https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in . Submit the application online between 13.10.2026 and 12.11.2026. Take a printout of the application form already uploaded in OAP. Forward the printout through your administrative Port along with the required documents on or before 27.11.2026, superscribing "Application for the post of Chief Engineer (HOD) in Mormugao Port Authority".

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection is by merit for which overall grading in the ACRs/APARs should not be below "Very Good". The bench mark in overall grading in the Annual Confidential Reports will not be below "Very Good".

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply online for Mormugao Port Authority Chief Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale for the Chief Engineer post?
faq.answer: The post carries a revised pay scale of Rs. 1,00,000-2,60,000, with elevation to Rs. 1,20,000-2,80,000 after three years of regular service.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers of Major Port Authorities and eligible candidates possessing a Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering with the required executive and service experience can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What documents are required to be attached with the forwarded printout?
faq.answer: Certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, availability statement of ACRs/APARs, attested educational certificates, no objection certificate, certificate by Head of Office, applicant undertaking, vigilance and administrative clearance, veracity certificates, and two recent passport size colour photographs are required.
